kind: Source inspection and constructed mathematical/cashflow checks, not historical or empirical alpha evidence
checks: stationary finite probability law sums to one
positive level autocorrelation with conditional reversion
fixed-reference middle does not imply zero expected price change
illustrative positive risk-premium expectation after assumed costs
locked two-venue cash spread needs no later price convergence
nearly perfect return correlation can coexist with nonstationary spread
growing expected fundamentals do not mechanically force a price gain

stationary_two_state.scope: Distinguish levels, changes and horizons; no claim that every reversion strategy has this law

fixed_reference.scope: Assumed one-period priced-risk distribution; not a discovered trading edge

simultaneous_arbitrage.scope: Outside narrow single-venue scope, but corrects the paper's own multi-venue extension; simultaneous execution/settlement assumed

income.scope: Source already acknowledges income in section3.6; it excludes/relabels it rather than proving it absent

correlated_log_random_walks.scope: Correlation alone does not establish cointegration or profitable convergence

expected_growth.scope: Hypothetical already-anticipated growth; not a valuation model or company observation

decision: DO NOT TEST: no new complete rule, causal regime classifier or CME evidence; taxonomy is not an alpha hypothesis
